director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket pitch jaise place karenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Achha, Riya. Cricket pitch mein stump 0 aur doosra stump 1 maan lo.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Arre, cricket mein sixer maara—ball seedha boundary ke paar! Is baat par question ke turant baad wapas aayenge. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3

near 3 sahi nahi hai. Aur cricket ki baat: Cricket mein ek over mein chhe ball hoti hain, aur ek team mein gyarah khiladi. Screen par ghar se chai ki dukaan tak 0 se 1 km ki sadak hai, aur khilona beech wale mark par ruka hai. Woh ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka number 1/2 km hai, 0 aur 1 ke beech. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
mujhe nahi pata

Poori sadak 1 km hai aur 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Ek hissa poore ka kaunsa fraction hai, woh socho. Wahi 0 se 1 km ki sadak ab 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Khilona pehle hisse ke end par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?
director.card: Wahi 0 se 1 km ki sadak ab 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Khilona pehle hisse ke end par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?

director.text: 1/8 km hai na

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki sadak 8 barabar hisson mein hai, toh pehle hisse ka end 1/8 km par hai. Aur pehle wale sawaal ka jawab isi line par tha, kyunki 1/3 ka matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps mein se pehla gap, toh woh isi line par hai. Screen par upar wahi 0 se 1 ki line hai, par ab beech mein 3 marks hain. Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Neeche ek doosri line hai, jis par beech mein 7 marks hain. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan
Riya, ab marks ginne ke bajaay unke beech ki barabar dooriyan ginogi. Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
director.card: Neeche wali line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Woh line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: 7 sahi nahi hai. Screen par 0 se 1 metre tak ka ribbon hai, beech mein 3 chalk ke nishaan hain, aur ribbon 4 barabar hisson mein bata hai. Fraction hisse ka naam hai, nishaan ka nahi, isliye pehla nishaan 1/4 metre par hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?

Virat yaad hai, yeh part khatam karke uspar aate hain. Is baat par tumhare sawaal ke turant baad wapas aayenge. 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?
director.card: 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?

director.text: 1/7 m sahi nahi hai. Aur Virat ki baat: Virat Kohli India ke liye batting karte hain, aur unka cover drive bahut mashhoor hai. 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?
director.card: 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?

director.text: ek bata aath metre

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 7 nishaan ribbon ko 8 barabar hisson mein baantte hain, aur pehla nishaan pehle hisse ke end par hai. Aur pehle wale sawaal ka jawab 8 tha, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain, 7 + 1 = 8. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line ab 8 barabar gaps mein bati hai, toh har gap pehle se chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, bilkul 0 ke paas, aur beech wala mark abhi bhi 1/2 hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan, samajh aaya
Ab ek nayi number-line practice karte hain, Riya. Gaps ko dhyaan se ginogi, marks ko nahi. Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?
director.card: Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

director.text: pata nahi
Line ke jitne zyada gaps, har gap utna chhota. Isliye 1/8 wala pehla mark 0 ke bilkul paas hai. Ab isse aage chalte hain.
drawing karke samjhao
Dekho, yahi 1/8 aur 1/2 ab patti par. Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?
director.card: Agar yahi line 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1 by 10

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 10 barabar gaps ka har gap 5 gaps wale gap se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
aapko virat pasand hai?

Virat: pakka, thodi der mein uski baat. Pehla kadam dekho. Line banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
hindi mein batao na
Theek hai, ab Hindi mein. Ghar ko 0 aur school ko 1 maan kar, beech ki doori ko barabar hisson mein baantte hain. Pehla kadam kya hoga?
haan
Accha, batane ke liye thanks! Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
hmm, achha
Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?

1/3 km sahi nahi hai. Ghar se school tak 1 km ko 4 barabar tukdon mein baanta hai. Tum try karo. Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, har gap 1/4 km ka, aur pehla khamba 0 se ek gap par hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 km door hai, kyunki raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, har gap 1/4 km ka, aur pehla khamba 0 se ek gap par hai. Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki line hai, aur beech mein 2 marks barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa bhinn hai?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai, kyunki beech ke 2 marks line ko 3 barabar gaps mein baantte hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai. Tumne do marks se bane teen barabar gaps dekhe—tumhe yeh kaise pata chala?
jaise aapne samjhaya tha, waise hi kiya
Tumne marks aur gaps ka sambandh yaad rakha. Ek baar 0 se 1 ko 3 barabar gaps mein baanto, ek baar 10 barabar gaps mein. 0 ke zyada paas kaun hai: 1/3 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/10 hai na
Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 10 gaps wala hissa 3 gaps wale hisse se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. 0 se 3 tak ki sankhya rekha par 1/2 kin do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?
director.card: 0 se 3 tak ki sankhya rekha par 1/2 kin do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?

at 2 sahi nahi hai. 1/2, 0 ke baad aur 1 se pehle wali jagah par hai. 0 se 3 tak ki sankhya rekha par 1/2 kin do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?

director.text: 0 aur 1

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 1/2 ek poore ka aadha hai, toh woh 0 aur 1 ke beech aata hai. Ab tak humne 0 se sirf ek gap liya, jaise 1/4. Agle hisse mein 0 se 2 ya 3 gap chalenge, aur upar ka number batayega ki kitne gap chalna hai. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line 3 barabar gaps mein bati hai. 0 se 2 hop lage hain, har hop 1/3 ka, aur hum 2/3 wale mark par pahunche. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
mujhe nahi pata
Line ke 3 barabar gaps hain, har gap 1/3. 0 se 2 hop lo, aur tum 2/3 par pahunchte ho. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
haan
Ab har hop ko ek chhota, barabar tukda samjho. Ab line ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis bhinn par pahunchoge?
director.card: Ab line ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto aur 0 se 3 hop lo. Kis bhinn par pahunchoge?

director.text: 3/4 hai na
Haan, sahi hai, kyunki har hop 1/4 ka hai aur 0 se 3 hop liye, toh hum 3/4 par hain. Tumne kul 4 gaps aur 0 se 3 hops pehchaane—ab batao, yeh kyun kaam karta hai?
jaise aapne samjhaya tha, waise hi kiya

Achha, tumne apna tareeka bataya. Screen par teesra hop dekho: woh theek 1 par utra, aur wahan likha hai 3/3 = 1. 3/3 mein upar aur neeche barabar hain, isliye hop theek 1 par khatam hue. Agar har hop 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se chalkar theek 1 tak pahunchne mein kitne hop lagenge?
director.card: Agar har hop 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se chalkar theek 1 tak pahunchne mein kitne hop lagenge?
